items.name: tokens
items.title: Design tokens
items.description: Color, typography, spacing, radius, motion, shadow, focus ring, blur, and glass material tokens. Single source of truth for the visual system.

items.name: theme-provider
items.title: Theme provider
items.description: React context that exposes tokens and follows the system color scheme.

items.name: glass
items.title: Liquid Glass
items.description: Resolves glass material tokens into a fill, border, and blur strength, plus the backdrop layer that hosts a blur view. Pulled in by components that support `surface="glass"`.

items.name: haptics
items.title: Haptics
items.description: Haptic feedback wrapper that no-ops when expo-haptics is not installed. Pulled in by components that use press feedback.

items.name: animated-icons
items.title: Animated icons
items.description: Thirty-one stateful SVG icon transitions and feedback animations for common app interactions.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Accessible action buttons for primary, secondary, ghost, outline, danger, loading, and icon-only use cases.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A card surface plus the four presets built on it: StatCard (metric with a rolling counter, signed delta, and inline sparkline), ListCard and ListCard.Group (rows with leading/trailing slots and hairline separators), MediaCard (cover image below or overlaid with a scrim), and ActionCard (icon, pitch, and buttons). Supports media, padding, press, and Liquid Glass.

items.name: animated-counter
items.title: Animated counter
items.description: A number that rolls between values instead of snapping: each digit is its own 0-9 column, and characters that appear as the number changes places fade in. Shared by Stepper and Chart.

items.name: stepper
items.title: Stepper
items.description: A numeric stepper with hold-to-repeat, a `min` floor, and a rolling counter animation. Ships in both input appearances: the filled field row and the large plain amount display.

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: Inline sparkline used by StatCard. The other chart forms live on a separate branch.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A reduced-motion-aware loading placeholder with text, rectangle, and circle geometry plus shimmer, pulse, or static presentation.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: A reduced-motion-aware activity indicator in five iOS idioms — stepped spokes, a sweeping arc, staggered dots, breathing bars, or radar pulses — at three sizes.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Secondary navigation for categorising content or switching views, with plain, underline, and separate filled appearances plus neutral or accent selection.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A bottom drawer with a grabber, drag-to-dismiss, snap points, tunable motion/gesture, default or stacked width, token-based height and padding, plus composable solid or Liquid-Glass surfaces.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Composable text-field primitive (Label, Control, Icon, Action, Input, Toolbar, Helper) shared by Input and TextArea.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A filled text input with labels, helper text, validation, icons, actions, password, and search patterns.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: An animated check box with two sizes, check icon, and disabled state.

items.name: radio
items.title: Radio
items.description: An animated radio button with a scaling dot indicator, two sizes, and disabled state.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: An animated on/off switch with two sizes, disabled state, and smooth thumb transition.

items.name: text-area
items.title: TextArea
items.description: A multiline text field for comments, notes, bios, support messages, and long-form form content.

items.name: tab-bar
items.title: Tab Bar
items.description: An animated bottom navigation bar with full-width and floating layouts, transparent or filled surfaces, badges, labels, and scroll-aware visibility.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: A gesture-driven horizontal carousel with item or page snapping, peek, pagination dots, auto-play, and loop support.

items.name: gallery
items.title: Gallery
items.description: A flexible grid layout with 1–4 columns, optional masonry mode, and token-based gap and corner radius.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A non-interactive status label with dot, count, and icon variants across five semantic tones.

items.name: chip
items.title: Chip
items.description: An interactive compact element for filters, input tokens, and actions with press feedback and remove affordance.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: A transient notification surface with contrast or same-as-background color styles, optional icon and dismiss, swipe-to-dismiss, and auto-dismiss. Mount the Toaster and call useToast() to stack several into a deck.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date Picker
items.description: Accessible calendar and wheel surfaces for date, time, date-time, and month-year selection.
